content: ROUGE: ROUGE is a commonly used evaluation metric for summarization. It measures the N-gram overlap between generated and training headlines. We use it to evaluate the relevance of generated headlines. The widely used pyrouge toolkit is used to calculate ROUGE-1 (RG-1), ROUGE-2 (RG-2), and ROUGE-L (RG-L).
